title: Expand the numerator
text: The Maclaurin series of cos(x) starts $$1-\frac{x^2}{2}+\frac{x^4}{24}$$, followed by higher powers of $$x$$.

title: Simplify and take the limit
text: So dividing $$cos(x)-1$$ by $$x^2$$ gives $$\frac{-1}{2}+\frac{x^2}{24}$$ plus higher powers of $$x$$, which approaches $$\frac{-1}{2}$$ as $$x$$ approaches $$0$$.
